name: How much does a home extension cost per square foot in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does a home extension cost per square foot in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: How much does a home extension cost per square foot in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Home extension pricing in Los Angeles varies widely because every project has different structural and finish requirements. A straightforward ground-floor addition is typically less expensive than a second-story addition, which usually requires engineering, reinforcement, and roof reconstruction. Bathrooms and kitchens also cost more per square foot because of plumbing, waterproofing, cabinetry, and appliance work. In higher-end neighborhoods and luxury homes, custom millwork, large openings, and premium materials can move costs well above standard ranges. Homeowners should compare pricing by scope, not just by square footage, because a small but complex addition can cost more per square foot than a larger, simpler one. The most accurate estimate comes from a site visit, existing-plan review, and a scope that clearly lists finishes, structural work, and utility changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most Los Angeles home extensions fall somewhere between about $200 and $650 per square foot, depending on whether the project is a simple ground-floor addition, a bathroom, a kitchen expansion, or a second-story build. Luxury finishes, structural changes, and hillside conditions can push costs higher.
